rationale: The lifecycle change revises the object-category scheme and explicitly says the vulnerable-road-user vs other-object distinction must be reassessed. In the baseline, H1-ORR2 is supported by the assumption H1-A2 and revalidation condition H1-RC2, which both depend on FR-7.2.2 and the object-category scheme. The Evaluation Target and Phenomenon of Interest remain unchanged, so the impact is limited to revalidating H1-ORR2.
